#Merge slides if needed 
```{r}
cell_profiler_process_path <- "/Users/compt/SynologyDrive/iPSC-hepatocyte experiment/Staining/IPSC (ch0=dapi, ch1= oct4, ch2=sox2)/output/"

merge_data <- function(cell_profiler_process_path, slide = NULL) {
  
  # Automatically detect plate folders
  if (is.null(slide)) {
    slide <- list.dirs(cell_profiler_process_path,
                        recursive = FALSE,
                        full.names = FALSE)
    slide <- slide[str_detect(slide, "^Slide")]
  }
  
  add_suffix <- function(df, suffix, key_cols) {
    non_key <- setdiff(names(df), key_cols)
    rename_with(df, ~ paste0(.x, suffix), all_of(non_key))
  }
  
  merge_slide <- function(slide_dir, slide_name) {
    
    Nuclei     <- read_csv(file.path(slide_dir, "Nuclei.csv"),     show_col_types = FALSE)
    Perinuclei <- read_csv(file.path(slide_dir, "Perinuclei.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    key_cols <- names(Nuclei)[1:7]
    
    Nuclei     <- add_suffix(Nuclei,     "_nuclei",     key_cols)
    Perinuclei <- add_suffix(Perinuclei, "_perinuclei", key_cols)
    
    join_keys <- Reduce(intersect,
                        list(names(Nuclei), names(Perinuclei)))
    
    Nuclei %>%
      full_join(Perinuclei, by = join_keys)
  }
  
  map_dfr(slide, function(slide) {
    slide_dir <- file.path(cell_profiler_process_path, slide)
    message("Reading: ", slide_dir)
    merge_slide(slide_dir, slide_name = slide)
  })
}

all_data <- merge_data(cell_profiler_process_path)
```

#Find thresholds
```{r}
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Sox2_ratio = Intensity_MedianIntensity_Sox2_nuclei /
                  (Intensity_MedianIntensity_Sox2_perinuclei)
  )

hist(all_data$Sox2_ratio, breaks = 10)

#greater than 1 = pos
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Sox2_status = ifelse(is.na(Sox2_ratio) | Sox2_ratio <= 1, "Sox2_neg", "Sox2_pos") #i checked some status is NA become NHFa4 median intensity is 0 i set to negative
  )


all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    OCT4_ratio = Intensity_MedianIntensity_Oct4_nuclei/
                  (Intensity_MedianIntensity_Oct4_perinuclei)
  )

hist(all_data$OCT4_ratio, breaks = 10)

#greater than 1 = pos
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    OCT4_status = ifelse(is.na(OCT4_ratio) | OCT4_ratio <= 1, "OCT4_neg", "OCT4_pos") #i checked some status is NA become median intensity is 0 i set to negative
  )


hist <- all_data %>%
  select(
    Metadata_slide,
    Metadata_coverslip,
    Metadata_sex,
    SOX2  = Intensity_MedianIntensity_Sox2_nuclei,
    OCT4    = Intensity_MedianIntensity_Oct4_nuclei
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
     cols      = -c(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex, Metadata_coverslip),  # pivot everything except the slide column
    names_to  = "marker",
    values_to = "intensity"
  )

ggplot(hist, aes(x = intensity, fill = marker, color = marker)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_grid(marker ~ Metadata_slide + Metadata_sex , 
             scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Mean Intensity", y = "Density", 
       title = "Per-slide intensity thresholds") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

#Classify cells
```{r}
# Classify cells
all_data_classified <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    Sox2_pos = Sox2_status == "Sox2_pos",
    OCT4_pos = OCT4_status == "OCT4_pos",

    # Detailed phenotype (
  class = case_when(
      Sox2_pos &  OCT4_pos  ~ "Sox2+/Oct4+",    
      Sox2_pos &  !OCT4_pos ~ "Sox2+/Oct4-",
    !Sox2_pos &  OCT4_pos ~ "Sox2-/Oct4+",
  TRUE ~ "Non-IPSC"
)) %>%
select(1:7,
         Intensity_MedianIntensity_Sox2_nuclei,
         Intensity_MedianIntensity_Oct4_nuclei,
         Sox2_pos, OCT4_pos, 
         class)
```


#Plot  class
```{r}
custom_colors <- c("#330597", "#9c179e","#cc4778", "#ed7953", "#fdb42f")
# Summarize phenotype frequencies
# Step 1: Calculate percentages per image
class_image <- all_data_classified %>%
  group_by(Metadata_slide, Metadata_image, class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Metadata_slide,, Metadata_image) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Calculate means across images within each slide
class_slide <- class_image %>%
  group_by(Metadata_slide, class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Calculate means and SE across slides within each sex
class_summary <- class_slide %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(
    grand_mean = mean(mean_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(mean_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n))

# Set class order
class_summary$class <- factor(
  class_summary$class,
  levels = c(
    "Sox2+/Oct4+",
    "Sox2+/Oct4-",
    "Sox2-/Oct4+",
    "Non-IPSC"
  )
)
p <- ggplot(
  class_summary,
  aes(x = class, y = grand_mean, fill = factor(class))
) +
  geom_col(
    alpha = 0.15,
    width = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = grand_mean - se,
      ymax = grand_mean + se
    ),
    width = 0.2
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    data = class_slide,
    aes(
      x = class,
      y = mean_percent,
      fill = factor(class),
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 3,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.7,
      jitter.width = 0.15
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "class") +

  labs(y = "%", x = NULL) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )
p
#ggsave("../plots/class.png", plot = p, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300,bg = "white")

class_grouped <- class %>%
  mutate(bar_group = ifelse(class == "Non-IPSC", "Non-IPSC", "IPSC"))

p_stacked_IPSC <- ggplot(class_grouped,
       aes(x = bar_group,
           y = mean_percent,
           fill = factor(class))) + 
  geom_col( 
    alpha = 0.85,
    width = 0.5,
    position = position_stack()
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors, name = "Phenotype") +
  
  labs(y = "%", x = NULL) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

p_stacked_IPSC
```
